claims.claim: On September 24, 2026 Infleqtion announced that its Sqale platform achieved 30 entangled logical qubits using 80 physical qubits, reaching the 30-logical-qubit milestone that earlier Scout evidence had treated as a forward 2026 execution target.

The disclosed milestone materially changes the prior execution evidence: the 30-logical-qubit target is no longer solely forward-looking, while the company's next stated roadmap target of 100 logical qubits by 2028 remains prospective.

risks.risk: The milestone is issuer-reported and does not by itself establish customer economics, fault-tolerant application utility, normalized margins or scalable recurring revenue.

contradictions.contradiction: Prior evidence correctly described 30 logical qubits as a forward 2026 target; the September 24 milestone supersedes that specific execution-status assumption but not the broader commercialization-stage tension.

unknowns.unknown: Independent technical replication and customer-level economic utility of the 30-logical-qubit configuration remain open.
